evidence.title: Alpy Taste | AI Design Skills & Web Design Styles

name: Alpy Taste
summary: MCP server that hands AI coding tools a design system, 21 web design styles and 12 UI design skills.
description: Alpy MCP connects Cursor, Codex, Claude, Gemini and Figma to an Alpy Library: React and Vue components, semantic and component tokens in light and dark modes, and design-taste skills — 21 web design styles (Academia, Art Deco, Bauhaus, Bento Grid, Bold Typography, Cyberpunk, Modern Dark, Neumorphism, Swiss …) and 12 UI skills, plus responsive and accessibility audits. A free plan keeps one library in the browser; Pro ($49 per library) connects it to Alpy MCP.
